about_the_game:
The Storyteller is a multiplayer investigation game for up to 5 players, where one takes on the role of the narrator — the Storyteller — and the other four become investigators tasked with uncovering mysterious cases. Set in a suspenseful universe with a humorous twist, the game presents intriguing stories that lead to unpredictable, often comical endings, featuring unique and exaggerated characters.

For those who prefer to play solo, The Storyteller also offers a single-player mode: you step into the role of an investigator and interact in real time with an AI narrator that tells the story and responds to your voice input, delivering an immersive and dynamic experience.

Mystery, deduction, and laughter come together in a game where nothing is quite what it seems — and the solution might be as absurd as it is brilliant.

content_descriptors.notes: There may be swearing and death themes.
